prs.title: Bootstrap tech-demos monorepo + earstrip vs earcut demo app
prs.summary: Adds monorepo rules (AGENTS.md, planning skill) and the first demo: a Vite/React tool that draws the same polygon with earcut and earstrip, times both, and loads 59 committed OSM building footprints. No backend.
diffNotes: All files are additions on top of the empty main README.
The interesting runtime path is triangulate.ts calling earcut(), earstrip(), and earstrip.strips().
On a self-intersecting pentagram, list mode can return 0 triangles while strips() adds crossing points.

prs.title: Implement the experimental Hooks proposal behind a feature flag
prs.summary: The 2018 Hooks PR. Public hook APIs, hook state on a fiber, a server dispatcher, and eslint-plugin-react-hooks — all behind enableHooks. Class components stay the default path.
diffNotes: Famous public PR (PR Lens's own marketing cites react#13968).
Client path: ReactHooks.js → dispatcher → ReactFiberHooks.js → scheduler / commit.
Server path is a separate PartialRendererHooks.js so SSR stays sync and effects are no-ops.
